# INV-USD-001 settled by the payment that arrived net of a USD fee.
#
# `amount: 105` — what the customer paid. The bank credited 100 and kept 5,
# and the receivable is cleared by the whole 105.
#
# The fee is in the settlement's own currency, so nothing converts — and it is
# refused all the same, in the same words the CAD fee earns. Naming the split
# says which split settles the invoice; it does not say what that split is
# worth, and a parked split's own figure never does. Whether the customer paid
# 105 with the fee borne here or 100 with the fee theirs is not in the book.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal quoting the 100.00 the bank received,
# the 5.00 fee beside it, and both readings.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
invoice "INV-USD-001"
  customer_id: "C-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
    memo: "Invoice INV-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-02-28
    amount: 105
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    txn_guid: "9a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f9"
    txn_split_guid: "c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f900112"
